Enrich person.title: Vice President Configuration Operations
Enrich person.summary:
Senior Operations Executive with extensive experience in operations management, business process management, and technology innovation. Recognized for excellent leadership and people management skills, which foster a collaborative work environment. Proven track record of building strong organizational teams that successfully execute goals and objectives, achieve results efficiently, and deliver enhanced provider and member service. Significant expertise including process improvement, claims administration, claims solutions, benefit configuration, systems enhancements, and leading cross-functional initiatives.

Core Competencies
·        Business Transformation: Leading initiatives that drive organizational change and improve business outcomes.
·        Process Improvement: Implementing strategies to optimize workflows and increase operational efficiency.
·        Service Delivery: Ensuring high-quality service experience for both providers and members.
·        System Migrations: Overseeing transitions to new systems to support business needs and modernization.
·        Quality Improvement: Advocating for continuous improvement to maintain and elevate standards.
·        Policy and Procedures: Developing and refining policies to support organizational objectives.
·        Portfolio Management: Managing diverse programs and projects to achieve strategic goals.
·        Team Building: Creating cohesive teams that perform at high levels.
·        Workflow Design: Structuring processes for maximum effectiveness and efficiency.
·        Business Initiative Leadership: Guiding key business initiatives from conception to execution.
·        Organizational Design: Structuring organizations to best meet strategic and operational needs.
·        Leadership Development: Mentoring and developing talent to ensure ongoing organizational success.
Enrich person.headline: Vice President Benefit Strategy and Delivery

experience.title: Vice President Benefit Strategy and Delivery
experience.summary: Leads enterprise wide benefit strategy and delivery, owning a significant portfolio that defines benefit strategy and drives the execution of benefit capabilities and product enhancements across all lines of business and markets. This role is accountable for high stakes initiatives spanning technology modernization, automation, regulatory delivery, and operational performance, ensuring accurate, accessible benefit information for providers, members, and internal stakeholders. Partnering closely with senior leaders across product, technology, operations, clinical, and experience teams, the role aligns enterprise priorities, enables transformation at scale, and advances innovative solutions that strengthen the benefit ecosystem and support sustainable growth.

experience.title: Vice President Benefit Configuration and Claims Solutions
experience.summary: Responsible for defining and executing the enterprise strategy for Benefit Configuration and Claims Solutions within Government Operations, supporting Medicare & Retirement and Community & State market segments. Accountable for end to end claims configuration, adjudication optimization, technology modernization, and large scale change management to improve automation, accuracy, regulatory compliance, and member and provider experience. Led multi layered onshore and offshore teams, partnered closely with health plans and customer segments, and provided executive oversight of core Medicaid and Medicare claims technology solutions to drive operational excellence, affordability, and growth.

experience.title: Senior Director, Configuration Operations Community and State
experience.summary: Delivering benefit configuration and claims solutions for the Community and State, Dual Special Needs Population, and Individual Exchange lines of business on the Facets platform.  This includes ensuring benefit and claims requirements are implemented accurately and made available to all stakeholders timely to deliver best in class service to our members and providers.

experience.title: Vice President, Strategic Operations
experience.summary: Responsible for managing key strategic projects that improve profitability and cash flow as well as help the company meet revenue and growth goals.  Work cross functionally with all operational, technical, legal, network management, client services, account management, compliance and human resource partners to ensure the successful implementation of strategic projects. Manage strategic vendor relationships that are critical to meeting the goals and objectives of strategic operations.

experience.title: Vice President of Operations
experience.summary: Responsible for all Northeast Operations, including Claims, Call Centers, Membership Accounting, Recoveries, Financial Operations, Quality & Training, and Systems Configuration. Managed 900+ staff with a $56M budget, ensuring productivity and quality during United’s acquisition of Health Net’s northeast membership and subsequent operational wind-down.

experience.title: Vice President Configuration
experience.summary: Oversaw configuration functions for both east and west coasts, managing contracted and non-contracted provider databases, setting rates and fee schedules for physicians, hospitals, and ancillary providers, as well as member benefit plan configurations. Guided the National Operations Project Portfolio team through project prioritization, requirements analysis, system design reviews, development and execution of user acceptance testing scripts, and comprehensive project implementation.
